FROM DOWNLOAD TO SETUP

Fewer steps.
A clearer path.

You do not need to start with separate downloads for every app. MM Auto is your starting point.

Download MM Auto

  1. Download and install MM Auto

    Download the official APK and open it on your phone. Allow app installation if Android asks.

  2. Choose your app

    Open MM Auto, choose MM Tube or MM IPTV, then tap Install and follow the Android prompt.

  3. Complete setup if needed

    Start with standard installation. If you need extra help, open in-app help. Android Auto compatibility varies by device and system version.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few useful answers.

Which app should I download first?

Start with MM Auto. It manages MM Tube and MM IPTV downloads and updates, and checks for its own updates too.

Do I need Shizuku?

Not everyone needs it. Start with standard installation. Some devices may need additional setup using Shizuku, a separate helper that you start and authorize on your phone.

Does installing guarantee it appears in the car?

No. Installing on the phone is separate from appearing and working in Android Auto. Check on your own setup and use the help options if needed. Use video only while safely parked.

Stable or preview: which should I choose?

The main download button gets the latest stable release. Preview builds are available on the releases page for testing new changes.
